# Synthetic fixture notice

The text and metadata in this directory were authored for Oscillink Safety Ops testing and are
dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0:
<https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>.

They are fictional, contain no customer or employee data, and are not operational instructions,
safety requirements, legal guidance, or evidence about real equipment. Expected audit findings are
kept in test code rather than fixture inputs.
